acoustic_impedance.modality: Acoustic/ultrasonic perturbation → measure acoustic impedance response
acoustic_impedance.physical_observable: Acoustic wave propagation speed/attenuation through shunt
acoustic_impedance.what_information: Fluid density, viscosity, obstruction density (different from pressure)
acoustic_impedance.credible_for_eShunt: PARTIAL — requires ultrasonic transducer on shunt; may be feasible
acoustic_impedance.novel_observable: YES — acoustic impedance is physically independent of hydraulic pressure
acoustic_impedance.estimated_information_gain: MEDIUM — could distinguish protein fouling (density change) from mechanical obstruction
acoustic_impedance.risk: Requires ultrasonic hardware on implant; power consumption; signal processing complexity

thermal_perturbation.physical_observable: Temperature response to localized heating pulse
thermal_perturbation.what_information: Thermal diffusivity = function of fluid composition, flow rate, obstruction
thermal_perturbation.credible_for_eShunt: PARTIAL — requires micro-heater + temperature sensor; feasible in implant
thermal_perturbation.novel_observable: YES — thermal diffusivity is physically independent of pressure
thermal_perturbation.estimated_information_gain: MEDIUM — could detect flow rate changes and obstruction type
thermal_perturbation.risk: Heating safety concerns; small signal; thermal diffusion in tissue

electrical_impedance.modality: Electrical impedance spectroscopy across shunt lumen
electrical_impedance.what_information: Fluid ionic composition, protein content, cell density
electrical_impedance.credible_for_eShunt: YES — electrode pairs on shunt wall are simple to implement
electrical_impedance.novel_observable: YES — ionic/protein composition is independent of hydraulic resistance
electrical_impedance.estimated_information_gain: HIGH — could distinguish fouling (protein deposition) from obstruction (cellular debris) from valve degradation (mechanical)
electrical_impedance.risk: Electrode fouling; CSF ionic variability; needs frequency sweep hardware

optical_sensing.modality: Optical absorption/scattering through transparent shunt window
optical_sensing.what_information: CSF composition, turbidity, protein content, drug concentration
optical_sensing.credible_for_eShunt: PARTIAL — requires optical window + light source; feasible but complex
optical_sensing.novel_observable: YES — optical properties are independent of pressure
optical_sensing.estimated_information_gain: HIGH — could directly measure drug concentration (#3 bridge) and fouling composition
optical_sensing.risk: Window fouling; light source power; biocompatibility of optical materials

flow_rate_direct.modality: Direct flow rate measurement (ultrasonic Doppler or thermal anemometry)
flow_rate_direct.what_information: Actual drainage rate (vs inferred from pressure differential)
flow_rate_direct.credible_for_eShunt: YES — flow sensor is straightforward in a shunt
flow_rate_direct.same_problem: SAME_PROBLEM_DIFFERENT_MECHANISM — direct flow vs inferred from pressure
flow_rate_direct.novel_observable: PARTIAL — flow rate is related to pressure but provides DIRECT measurement
flow_rate_direct.estimated_information_gain: MEDIUM — direct flow eliminates inference error but doesn't add fundamentally new physics

multi_perturbation_protocol.modality: Multiple valve perturbation PATTERNS (not just open/close) — e.g., pulse trains, ramp, hold
multi_perturbation_protocol.physical_observable: Same pressure signals but with richer excitation spectrum
multi_perturbation_protocol.what_information: Frequency-dependent response (transfer function at multiple frequencies)
multi_perturbation_protocol.credible_for_eShunt: YES — just requires different valve control patterns, no new hardware
multi_perturbation_protocol.same_problem: SAME_PROBLEM_SAME_MECHANISM — still hydraulic, but richer excitation
multi_perturbation_protocol.novel_observable: PARTIAL — frequency response could reveal non-linearities that single perturbation misses
multi_perturbation_protocol.estimated_information_gain: LOW-MEDIUM — V16 hybrid already tested temporal features with minimal gain
multi_perturbation_protocol.risk: V16 already showed temporal features don't help much

part_1_territory_1.verdict: NO credible new modality with HIGH information gain found. Best candidate (electrical_impedance) has score=3 (needs ≥6 for HIGH×YES). #1 mechanism space is EXHAUSTED — eligible for CEILING (noise-limited, no new physical observable).

part_2_territory_2.verdict: Size-selective filter retains antibodies (150kDa, well above MWCO) well but STRUGGLES with small molecules (500Da, below MWCO). This is a FUNDAMENTAL limitation of size-selective filtration — it only works for large therapeutics. For small molecules, hydrodynamic or mechanical retention may be better. The #2 candidate is payload-dependent — NOT universally best.

part_3_territory_5.verdict: Dual-pathway model CALIBRATED ✓. All scenarios non-zero: NO. V7 reduces thrombus by 100.0% vs CereVasc bare. Discrimination range: 1.0000. Pathway analysis reveals: CereVasc is driven by BIOCHEMICAL activation, V7 is driven by BIOCHEMICAL activation.
